desc: Derive and document the binary-state model: \(d_i=1+a_i-a_{i-1}+x_i\), allowed \(x_i\), and the proof that \(d_N\) is determined by \(\sum d_i\).
Implement the concise 16-relation deterministic DP with precomputed transition tables and multiplicities.
Optimize the implementation for \(N=10^6\) using fixed-size arrays, local variables, and efficient input handling.
Validate against the provided samples and confirm the solution passes the public sample tests.
